LESSON: SIGN READING 13.4.1 SIGNED ORAL LITERATURE: PRAISE SONGS

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade seven
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 13
Topic 13.4: Sign Reading 13.4.1 Signed Oral Literature: Praise Songs
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Sign Reading 13.4.1 Signed Oral Literature: Praise Songs, part of Strand 13 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade seven ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why do we sing? 2. How do songs portray people’s character?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. recognise signs of vocabulary related to the theme for effective communication,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Sign Reading 13.4.1 Signed Oral Literature: Praise Songs in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Sign Reading 13.4.1 Signed Oral Literature: Praise Songs together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Self-Efficacy: Learner develops the skill of self awareness as they share experiences while discussing what they found difficult in

praise songs.

● Creativity and imagination: Learner develops the skill of making observations as they gain new perspectives on how to perform praise

songs.

Values:
● Respect: is enhanced as learners perform praise songs in groups and respect each other’s roles.

Link to other Subjects

The learner relates oral literature skills to their learning in creative arts.
